review: The primary reader inspected the whole page and both supplied halves before reading C and H. Eight broad crops at 4–5× and forty-two focused or supplementary crops at 8–16× were then read. The first requested projective crop was truncated in tool output; it was displayed again and actually read before decisions were made. The vertical relation was rotated clockwise 90 degrees, the cancelled lower-left word clockwise 1 degree, and the L insertion twice clockwise 4 degrees. Every agreed word and sign, all C doubts, all H differences, the crossed passages, and the mathematical indices and endpoints were checked against the ink. A second view of the whole page was used to check placement and omissions before the inventory was written. The sequence opening, initially provisionally read as C, was changed only after the focused 9× and 16× views showed the rounded first object and a separate capped shaft. No OCR, context or delegated manuscript reading was used.
